subject.title: fix: block mixed-case cron shell jobs from agent tool [AI]

question: Is targeted cron-tool executor coverage enough proof for this protected shell-execution boundary fix, or should the contributor add a real agent/Gateway rejection transcript before merge?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but ClawSweeper policy treats external PR real-behavior proof as a merge gate unless a maintainer explicitly overrides it, and this PR touches a shell-execution boundary.

options.title: Request real runtime proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal/live output showing mixed-case command and on-exit cron tool calls rejected before Gateway dispatch.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the targeted executor tests as sufficient for this small boundary fix and proceed with normal merge checks.
